name: How To Vote
overview: Scripture teaches that choosing leaders is a serious responsibility that should be grounded in wisdom and godly understanding, as God directed the Israelites to select wise men to govern them (Deuteronomy 1:13). While human rulers serve a role, the ultimate authority belongs to the LORD, who governs nations and directs the hearts of kings according to His will (Psalms 22:28; Proverbs 21:1). Trust should not be placed in mere princes or men for salvation (Psalms 146:3), but nations are exalted through righteousness and brought low through sin (Proverbs 14:34). Even when establishing kingship, the people are to recognize God's sovereignty over all earthly governance (Deuteronomy 17:14).
